written: 2026-10-21 ~09:45 JST, before any v11 training episode; approved by the user ("开跑！")
motivation: v10 (more inputs) was worse than frozen v9 on identical blind cases (1.137 vs 1.074): the bottleneck is ES training, not missing inputs

defect: with 4 cases per task per generation, bench9.cases9 gives ES the same direction slots every generation (dash 0/45/90/135 only; redirect one turn handedness only) and only stress strata 0-3; selection/blind cover all
ES objective of 12 episodes is noisy (training gains do not transfer to selection), and late ES is unstable (all 15 v9/v10 seeds crash on selection after gen 2-10)

es.coverage: every generation: all 8 dash directions, all 8 redirect pairs, all 4 evade directions x2, all 8 strata (descend12 selftest)
es.ranking: crash-aware: any crashed episode ranks the candidate below all crash-free ones

change.selection: 64 validation cases per task (all directions, both turns), 0 crashes and 0 over-hard-tilt required, minimum objective

unchanged: bench10 scoring, classical opponents, normalisers (plan v9 baseline.json)

primary.name: M6
primary.per_seed: average manoeuvre ratio <= 0.95 AND crashed episodes <= classical crashed episodes on the same 192 blind cases

secondary: S1 paired: v11 selected centres vs frozen v9 centres on the v11 blind set
S2 per-direction and per-class ratios (trained-vs-previously-untrained directions)
not_allowed: changing scoring, opponents, blind set or criterion after seeing v11 results
